releases.notes: Fixes duplicates going undetected. If you added a kit that duplicated samples the app had already scanned, those copies were never reported. Press Rescan once after updating and they will show up.
changes: Rescan now finds duplicates of samples that were already scanned in an earlier session
Permanently deleting a batch clears its files from the index instead of leaving stale entries behind

releases.notes: Fixes permanent delete failing silently. If a delete can't finish, the app now says which file blocked it and lets you open the folder to finish the job yourself.
changes: Failed deletes keep the batch listed and show a red notice naming the file that blocked it
Open folder button on every quarantine batch, plus Open quarantine folder beside the search box
Deleting a large batch shows a progress screen so it doesn't look frozen
Read-only files and very long file paths are handled on Windows

releases.notes: First release. Finds byte-identical duplicate samples across your kits and stages removals so nothing is deleted outright.
changes: Scans a sample library and finds duplicates by file contents, not filenames
Search by sample name, and sort by space reclaimable, copy count or file size
Play any copy before deciding, with the suggested keep marked
Removals staged in quarantine and restorable; permanent deletion is a separate action
